show_percentage.label: Show percentage
show_percentage.description: Show the battery percentage next to the icon.

hide_when_unavailable.label: Hide when unavailable
hide_when_unavailable.description: Hide the widget when no headset is connected or its battery level is unavailable.

missing_dependency.title: headsetcontrol is not installed
missing_dependency.hint: Install the headsetcontrol package, then refresh.

no_devices.title: No headset detected
no_devices.hint: Turn the headset on or plug in its USB dongle. If it is connected, make sure headsetcontrol's udev rules are installed.

error.title: Could not read headset status
error.hint: The last headsetcontrol call failed. Showing the last known data.
